cases.title: Show the awarded-vendor summary when no vendor is awarded

cases.setup: Use the current proposal with no awarded vendors.
gaps: The absence of a vendor summary specifically containing awarded amounts or awarded items cannot be asserted semantically because the catalog has no region- or field-level step for that summary.

cases.title: Open the hidden-fields list
